items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Sy Oliver making arrangements and interactions with Duke Ellington, but the interviewee (J.C. Higginbotham) does not respond with any personal anecdote, confirmation of meeting, or description of a professional relationship with Sy Oliver.

ctx.x: Do you happen to remember what year that was?
I sure don't remember but I know it was a helluva record. I'll never forget that. Sy Oliver made the arrangements, yeah. I have them, too.
They always talk about your relationship with Little Albert, Red Allen, that you have been associated with-
